name: Meng Huo
description: A stubborn barbarian king captured and released by Kongming seven times.

description_citations.work: Masters Edition III: card flavor text
description_citations.text: Masters Edition III: card flavor text (Masters Edition III, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kongming captures and releases Meng Huo seven times before he surrenders.
timeline.quote: The stubborn Meng Huo was captured and released by Kongming seven times before finally surrendering.

citation.text: Meng Huo, Barbarian King (Portal Three Kingdoms, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Lady Zhurong scolds her husband and vows to fight for him.
timeline.quote: I, a woman, will fight them for you.
